create_Checkpointer: create a Checkpointer for a PyTorch model with an optional save directory and optimizer
save_checkpoint: save a PyTorch model checkpoint to disk using the Checkpointer save method
load_checkpoint: load a PyTorch model checkpoint from a file path using the Checkpointer load method
resume_or_load_checkpoint: resume training from the last checkpoint or load a specific checkpoint file
create_PeriodicCheckpointer: create a PeriodicCheckpointer to automatically save model checkpoints every N training iterations
